turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My phone is three years old and the battery dies by lunchtime. I think it's time to replace it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's fair. Do you want to stick with the same brand, or are you open to switching to something new?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang tight, my dad is calling me over. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, have you seen my charger? The white one with the short cable.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I borrowed it this morning, sorry. It's next to my bed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I grab it? I'm down to five percent.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Go for it. We really need to buy a second one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Agreed. Maybe a long cable so it reaches the couch.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Good idea. Add it to the shopping list.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. So, same brand for the new phone, or a change?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, I want to try something new this time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun. Most phones have a transfer app now, so moving your photos and contacts is easier than it used to be.
